name: emporium
postCreateCommand: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y pulseview xvfb fluxbox x11vnc novnc websockify chromium && npm ci
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'set -e; pkill -f "Xvfb|fluxbox|x11vnc|websockify" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sudo mkdir -p /tmp/.X11-unix; sudo chmod 1777 /tmp/.X11-unix; Xvfb :1 -screen 0 1600x900x24 >/tmp/xvfb.log 2>&1 & export DISPLAY=:1; fluxbox >/tmp/fluxbox.log 2>&1 & x11vnc -display :1 -nopw -forever -shared -rfbport 5900 -noxdamage >/tmp/x11vnc.log 2>&1 & websockify --web=/usr/share/novnc 6080 localhost:5900 >/tmp/novnc.log 2>&1 &'
